summary: Inline const enum members when preserveConstEnums is false.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: inline
tests.input: const enum E { A=1 }; const x=E.A;
tests.expected_behavior: default emit substitutes value and emits no E object

tests.name: profile boundary
tests.input: const enum E { A=1 }; const x=E.A;
tests.expected_behavior: preserveConstEnums=true is a different rule profile
